name: Jamlech
overview: Jamlech is a male figure identified as a Simeonite, belonging to the tribe of Simeon. His unique attribute is noted in 1 Chronicles 4:34, though details about his life or role are minimal. There are no additional notes or elaborations on his character or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Jamlech means 'he will reign,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name with a hopeful or regal connotation. This meaning is recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:34, though the name was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jamlech as a descendant of Simeon, linking him to the tribe of Simeon as stated in 1 Chronicles 4:34. No further family relationships are documented beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jamlech's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Simeon, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:34. While details about his life are sparse, his inclusion in the biblical record affirms the faithfulness of God's preservation of His people’s lineage. This genealogical mention underscores the continuity of God's covenant promises through the tribes of Israel.
